physics-killer-12.title: Photoelectric effect, hunhu hwakaviri hwechiedza, nepasi diki
physics-killer-12.topic: Photoelectric effect, hunhu hwakaviri hwechiedza, nepasi diki
physics-killer-12.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-12.material: Mapuranga maviri anotenderera conductor akaiswa pamusoro peplane yakachinjika ane kuparadzana $\ell=0.5\,\mathrm{m}$, imwe pamucheto yakabatanidzwa neresistor. Total resistance yeclosed circuit inoumbwa nemarail, conductor rod neresistor ndi $2\,\Omega$. Vertical uniform magnetic field $B=0.5\,\mathrm{T}$ inoshanda pacircuit yose, uye conductor rod inofamba panhevedzano yemarail nokumhanya kwakaenzana $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ ichisiyana neresistor. Kana rod yafamba $0.5\,\mathrm{s}$ mukati $2\,\mathrm{m}$, magnetic flux inopfuura circuit inochinja ne $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x$. Ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama wehuwandu hweinduced current inoyerera nesimba rokunze rinodikanwa kuchengetedza rod nokumhanya kwakaenzana zvichitevedzana? (Hapana friction.)
physics-killer-12.thinking.0: Photoelectric effect, hunhu hwakaviri hwechiedza, nepasi diki
physics-killer-12.s.s1.prompt: Mapuranga maviri anotenderera conductor akaiswa pamusoro peplane yakachinjika ane kuparadzana $\ell=0.5\,\mathrm{m}$, imwe pamucheto yakabatanidzwa neresistor. Total resistance yeclosed circuit inoumbwa nemarail, conductor rod neresistor ndi $2\,\Omega$. Vertical uniform magnetic field $B=0.5\,\mathrm{T}$ inoshanda pacircuit yose, uye conductor rod inofamba panhevedzano yemarail nokumhanya kwakaenzana $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ ichisiyana neresistor. Kana rod yafamba $0.5\,\mathrm{s}$ mukati $2\,\mathrm{m}$, magnetic flux inopfuura circuit inochinja ne $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x$. Ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama wehuwandu hweinduced current inoyerera nesimba rokunze rinodikanwa kuchengetedza rod nokumhanya kwakaenzana zvichitevedzana? (Hapana friction.)
physics-killer-12.s.s1.explain: $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot2=0.5\,\mathrm{Wb}$, $|\mathcal E|=\dfrac{\Delta\Phi}{\Delta t}=\dfrac{0.5}{0.5}=1.0\,\mathrm{V}$ (kuenderana se $=B\ell v=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot4$). $I=\dfrac{\mathcal E}{R}=\dfrac{1.0}{2}=0.5\,\mathrm{A}$. Magnetic force inoshanda pa rod ndi $F=BI\ell=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot0.5=0.125\,\mathrm{N}$ (munzira inodzivirira kufamba zvinoenderana naLenz's law), uye kumhanya kwakaenzana, simba rokunze rinova $0.125\,\mathrm{N}$. Kutarisa: simba rokunze power $Fv=0.125\cdot4=0.5\,\mathrm{W}=I^2R=0.25\cdot2$. Kusiya $\ell$ kunopa $I=1.0\,\mathrm{A}$ (nhema ①), kusiya $\ell$ musimba kunopa $0.25\,\mathrm{N}$ (nhema ②), kukanganisa $\mathcal E$ ne $\frac12$ ndiyo nhema ④.
